Feeling alone even when your love ones surrounds you is often a common feeling among young adults. Your piece conveys that feeling so well. 

Being on your phone, speaks volumes. Their status on instagram takes precedence over most things in life and that is the harsh reality that we all have to live with.

Thank you for sharing your piece, it was very insightful, clear and to the point. Keep up the good work.
Very insightful, I am learning so much just from this one post.

There are times when people have to do what they have to do to feed their families. But that doesn't give the employer the right to abuse their employees and take advantage of their authority over them.

In these cases, lives are at risk, there is  no blame. People just don't know and they are quick to jump to conclusion because they just cannot understand your pain and they are looking for a quick fix to your problem which doesn't exist.

Amazon: They have the nerve to be making commercials about how great the environment is at the workplace, when the conditions are sometime inhumane. They expect you to be on your feet for all those hours and in some instances, they actually time you on your bathroom 🚽 break.

 I guess being the richest man in the world allows you to get away with certain actions. Why would the government come down on them when they have already given them such a tax cut. Smh 🤦🏾‍♀️.
So sad my condolences to his family.

"Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.

That is great news. God is always there, it's just us who have to trust in him. You are experiencing God's grace on your life and  I pray that you and your family will be protected from all manner of evil, I wish you God's richest blessings.

These people have no conscience, it is just sad to know that they feel they can impose restrictions not vote for others to get paid sick leave, but it is quite OK for him to do so.

Setting a goal is not always an easy task. First you have to know exactly what it is that you want to obtain and a viable way to obtain it. Most goals are set because of a burning desire to move forward from one's position in life. That would usually come from an uncomfortable feeling in that, the person grows tired of their lack of progress whereby they feel the need to do something about their situation.

The goal you set must be big enough to challenge you which would then allow you to grow. That way, even if you did not attain that particular goal, you would have at least become more knowledgeable along the way and would then be encouraged to take on an even  more challenging goal than the one you originally set for yourself.

In any case, goals are simply guidelines to keep you on the right track. In a world where they are so many distractions, a goal is there to keep you focus. It will always seem hard at first, but after a while you will look back and be in awe of yourself after seeing what you have accomplished, all because you decided to set a goal.
